remaining_survivors.name: crates/pricing/src/market/dividend.rs:344:33: replace || with && in AffineDividendTransform::compile_reserve

assessment.rationale: PositiveF64 makes Spot finite and positive. Valid cash, proportions and positive curve discounts make a finite reserve nonnegative, so Spot minus a finite reserve is finite. A NaN/infinite reserve makes the residual nonfinite too. Thus the two nonfinite predicates have the same truth value in the current domain; replacing their inner disjunction by conjunction preserves the result and error.
assessment.limitation: This reasoning depends on finite positive Spot and validated nonnegative reserve terms; a synthetic private negative reserve could invalidate it.

remaining_survivors.disposition: Still selected and MissedMutant; no exclusion or waiver.

remaining_survivors.name: crates/pricing/src/market/dividend.rs:482:37: replace && with || in AffineDividendTransform::coordinate_before_event

assessment.kind: redundant guard after checked state transitions
assessment.rationale: A successfully funded transform starts with finite A and B. carry checks updated A; after checks both A and B. coordinate_before_event only composes these checked steps, so both operands of its final finite test are true whenever execution reaches it.
assessment.limitation: Applies to transforms constructed through the current validation and a valid event index, with only this mutation; it does not assert behavior for synthetic invalid private states.
